articles.text: 第二十三條 學生上課出席狀況，應由任課老師登記於校務資訊系統之學生缺曠課系統。學生因故未能上課或到 考者，須依學生請假規則辦理請假。 Article 23 Student attendance in classes shall be recorded by the course instructor in the Student Absence and Truancy System of the University’s academic information system. Students who are unable to attend classes or examinations for any reason shall apply for leave in accordance with the Student Leave Regulations.

第二十四條 學生因故請假，經核准為缺課；未經准假任意缺席為曠課。缺課、曠課依照下列規定辦理： 一、因公假、懷孕、生產或撫育三歲以下子女之照顧，而核准之請假，不受缺課日數達該學期上課 總日數三分之一勒令休學之限制。 二、因懷孕、生產或撫育三歲以下子女之照顧，而核准之請假，其缺席不扣學業成績；致缺課時數 逾全學期授課時數三分之一者，該科目成績得視需要與科目性質以補考或以其他補救措施彈性處 理，補考成績並按實際成績計算。 Article 24 Leave of absence approved by the University shall be recorded as excused absence. Absence without prior approval shall be deemed unexcused absence. Excused absences and unexcused absences shall be handled in accordance with the following provisions: 1. Approved leave due to official duties, pregnancy, childbirth, or the need to care for children under the age of three shall not be subject to the regulation requiring suspension of studies when the number of absence days reaches one-third of the total class days in a semester. 2. Approved leave due to pregnancy, childbirth, or the need to care for children under the age of three shall not result in deduction of academic grades. If the number of absence hours exceeds one-third of the total instructional hours of the semester, the course grade may, depending on necessity and the nature of the course, be handled flexibly through make-up examinations or other remedial measures. Grades from make-up examinations shall be calculated based on the actual score obtained.

第二十五條 學生如因故申請休學每次以一學期為限，累計原則不得超過二學年，開學上課逾三分之一學期後不 得復學。 下列情形申請休學者 ( 應檢具相關證明文件 ) ，其休學期間不計入休學年限： 一、因應徵服義務役者。 二、因懷孕、分娩或撫育三歲以下子女者。 三、參加教育部「青年教育與就業儲蓄帳戶方案」或「青年生涯領航計畫」者。 學生休學辦法另訂之。 Article 25 Students applying for suspension of studies shall do so for one semester at a time. In principle, the cumulative suspension period shall not exceed two academic years. Students shall not apply for resumption of studies after more than one-third of the semester has elapsed. For the following circumstances (with supporting documentation provided), the suspension period shall not be counted toward the maximum allowable suspension duration: 1. Fulfillment of compulsory military service. 2. Pregnancy, childbirth, or the need to care for children under the age of three. 3. Participation in the Ministry of Education’s Youth Education and Employment Savings Account Program or Youth Career Exploration Program. Regulations governing student suspension of studies shall be separately prescribed.

第三十條 學生未滿十八歲者 ， 申請退學須經法定代理人或監護人同意；學士班日間部學生已滿十八歲 ( 含 ) 者， 申請退學時得由本校與學生家長確認。 退學生在本校修滿一學期以上，且有成績，其學籍並經核准者，辦理離校手續後發給轉學或修業證 明書。 未辦理完成離校手續之退學生，不發給任何有關學業之證明書。退學離校手續之相關程序與表單， 由承辦單位簽請教務長核定後實施。 因違反校規而退學之學生，不得重返本校肄業。 辦理退學離校之學生，應繳回數位學生證，數位學生證於退學離校生效日一年後銷毀。 Article 30 Students under the age of eighteen applying for withdrawal shall obtain the consent of their legal representative or guardian. Daytime undergraduate students aged eighteen or above may apply for withdrawal upon confirmation between the University and the student’s parents. Students who have completed at least one semester with academic records duly approved shall, upon completion of the withdrawal procedures, be issued a Certificate of Transfer or Certificate of Enrollment. Students who fail to complete the withdrawal procedures shall not be issued any academic certificates. The procedures and forms for withdrawal shall be implemented upon approval by the Dean of Academic Affairs. Students dismissed for violation of University regulations shall not be readmitted. Students completing withdrawal procedures shall return their digital student identification card, which shall be destroyed one year after the effective date of withdrawal.

第三十八條 學生合於下列各項條件者，准予畢業，本校授予學士學位，並於辦理完成離校手續後，發給學位證 書： 一、修業期滿，修滿應修之必修及選修科目學分。 二、操行成績平均及格。 三、符合經三級三審通過之校或系規定畢業門檻。 本校「畢業離校手續及核發學位證書作業要點」另訂之。 Article 38 Students who satisfy all of the following requirements shall be approved for graduation. The University shall confer a Bachelor’s degree and issue a diploma upon completion of withdrawal procedures: 1. Completion of the prescribed period of study and fulfillment of all required and elective credits. 2. A passing average conduct grade. 3. Fulfillment of graduation requirements established by the department or the University and approved through the three-level review process. The University’s Guidelines for Graduation Clearance Procedures and Issuance of Diplomas shall be separately prescribed.

第四十條 應屆畢業生缺修學分須於延長修業年限之第二學期修業者，第一學期得申請休學；註冊者至少應選 修一學科。 Article 40 Graduating students who must complete remaining credits in the second semester of an extended period of study may apply for suspension during the first semester of such extension. Students who register shall enroll in at least one course.

Admission regulations shall be formulated and submitted to the Ministry of Education for approval. Detailed admission brochures shall be separately prescribed. In accordance with applicable regulations, the University may admit international students, overseas

Page 3 / 28 Chinese students, students from Hong Kong and Macao, and students from Mainland China (hereinafter collectively referred to as “international students”). Relevant admission regulations shall be separately prescribed and submitted to the Ministry of Education for ratification. The University may, through international academic cooperation, confer degrees jointly with overseas institutions. Relevant regulations shall be separately prescribed. 第三條 凡在公立或已立案之私立高級中等學校或同等學校畢業，或合於相關同等學力資格學生，經入學考 試錄取者，得入本校四年制及二年制學士班、副學士班各系 ( 科 ) 一年級肄業。 凡在公立或已立案之私立專科以上學校畢業，或合於相關同等學力資格學生，經入學考試錄取者， 得入本校二年制學士班各系一年級肄業。 Article 3 Graduates of public or accredited private senior secondary schools or equivalent institutions, or those who meet equivalent academic qualifications and have been admitted through the entrance examination, may enroll in the first year of four-year bachelor’s programs or two-year bachelor’s and associate degree programs. Graduates of public or accredited private junior colleges or higher institutions, or those who meet equivalent academic qualifications and have been admitted through the entrance examination, may enroll in the first year of two-year bachelor’s programs. 第四條 本校各學系修讀學士班、副學士學位學生遇有缺額時，得辦理轉學考試，招收轉學生。但一年級及 應屆畢業年級不得招收轉學生，招收轉學生辦法另訂之，並報請教育部核定，據以擬定招生簡章辦 理招生。 前項缺額不含保留入學資格、休學造成之缺額；辦理轉學招生後學生總數不超過原核定及分發新生 總數。 Article 4 When vacancies arise in bachelor’s or associate degree programs, the University may conduct transfer admission examinations to recruit transfer students. However, first-year and graduating-year classes shall not admit transfer students. Regulations governing transfer admissions shall be separately prescribed and submitted to the Ministry of Education for approval, and admission brochures shall be formulated accordingly. Vacancies referred to in the preceding paragraph shall not include those resulting from deferred enrollment or leave of absence. The total number of students admitted through transfer shall not exceed the originally approved student quota. 第五條 凡經錄取之新生及轉學生，應於規定日期來校辦理入學手續；逾期不辦理者，取消其入學資格。

Page 4 / 28 Article 5 Admitted freshmen and transfer students shall complete enrollment procedures within the prescribed period. Failure to do so within the specified timeframe shall result in revocation of admission eligibility. 第六條 新生及轉學生因重病或其他特殊事故，不能於該學期開學時入學者，應以書面向教務處申請，並繳 驗入學證明文件，得保留入學資格一學期，其他相關事項依休學各項規定辦理。 有下列情形之一者，得於註冊基準日前，向學校申請保留入學資格，不受前項規定限制： 一、因懷孕、分娩或撫育三歲以下子女並持有證明者。 二、參加教育部「青年教育與就業儲蓄帳戶方案」或「青年生涯領航計畫」者。 Article 6 Freshmen and transfer students who are unable to enroll at the beginning of the semester due to serious illness or other special circumstances shall apply in writing to the Office of Academic Affairs and submit relevant supporting documents. Upon approval, enrollment eligibility may be deferred for one semester. Other related matters shall be handled in accordance with regulations governing leave of absence. The following circumstances shall not be subject to the limitation stated in the preceding paragraph, provided that application is made before the registration deadline: 1. Pregnancy, childbirth, or raising a child under three years of age, with supporting documentation. 2. Participation in Ministry of Education programs such as the Youth Education and Employment Savings Account Program or the Youth Career Navigation Program. 第二章 註冊 選課 抵免 Chapter 2 - Registration, Course Selection, and Credit Transfer 第七條 新生、轉學生入學報到時，須繳驗有效之學歷 ( 力 ) 證件，才得辦理入學手續，經審核不合者，取消 入學資格。其有正當理由，預先申請延後補繳證件而經核准者，得先行入學，但應於規定時間內補 繳，否則取消其入學資格。入學時並須親自填寫學生基本資料。 Article 7 Upon enrollment, freshmen and transfer students shall submit valid academic credentials for verification before completing admission procedures. If such credentials are found invalid upon review, admission eligibility shall be revoked. Where there is a legitimate reason, and prior approval has been obtained for deferred submission of credentials, students may complete enrollment provisionally; however, the required documents must be submitted within the prescribed period, failing which admission eligibility shall be revoked. Students shall personally complete and submit their basic personal information upon enrollment. 第七條之一
